fields.label: Send message
options: To all clients with an active booking — Sends a message to all clients in the selected billing class with the status Enrolled
To all clients — Sends a message to all clients regardless of bookings or billing periods
To a specific class — Sends a message to all clients in the selected class with the status Enrolled
To a single recipient — Sends email only to the selected email address
To selected bookings — Sends a message to selected bookings.

fields.label: Choose who you want to send the message to:
options: Clients — Message will be sent to each client just once. That means that if the client does have multiple bookings you won't be able to use merge fields specific for booking (such as COURSE_PRICE, or VARIABLE_SYMBOL). Best to use this for general announcements.

Individual bookings — Message will be sent to each booking that meets the criteria. This means that if a client has multiple bookings she will get an email per each booking. Best to use for messages regarding specific bookings.

fields.label: Promotional message
fields.help: Check if you do not want to send this message to those who are unsubscribed from promotional messages.
